title: Adhar Package Marketplace Contract
description: Compatibility contract and provenance metadata that every Adhar platform package MUST satisfy. Each package directory under platform/stack/packages/<category>/<name>/ carries one 'adhar-package.yaml' validated against this schema. See platform/stack/packages/MARKETPLACE.md and docs/adr/0019-secure-supply-chain-chainguard.md.

apiVersion.description: Contract API version. Bumped when the marketplace schema makes breaking changes.

name.description: Package name. MUST match the package directory name (platform/stack/packages/<category>/<name>/) and the ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet element name. Lowercase DNS-label style.

category.description: Marketplace category. MUST match the real top-level directory under platform/stack/packages/.

version.description: Package version. Conventionally tracks the upstream chart/app version being packaged (semver, optional leading 'v').

appVersion.description: Optional upstream application version this package deploys (e.g. the container image tag), distinct from the chart/package 'version'.

description.description: One-line human summary of what the package provides. Shown in the marketplace listing.

maintainer.description: The party responsible for keeping this package current and answering issues. First-party packages use the Adhar Platform Team; community packages name their contributor.

firstParty.description: True for packages maintained by adhar-io itself; false for community-contributed packages.

license.description: SPDX license identifier of the upstream project being packaged (e.g. Apache-2.0, MIT, AGPL-3.0). Use 'Proprietary' for closed-source.

homepage.description: Optional upstream project homepage or docs URL.

adharCompatibility.description: The range of Adhar platform versions this package is verified against. minVersion is required; omit maxVersion for open-ended forward compatibility.

minVersion.description: Lowest Adhar platform version (globals/project.go Version) this package supports.

maxVersion.description: Highest Adhar platform version known-good. Omit for open-ended support.

dependencies.description: Other Adhar packages that MUST be enabled for this package to function. Each entry references a package by name (and optionally its category and a version constraint). Conflicts are tracked separately in CONFLICTS.md.

versionConstraint.description: Optional semver range constraint on the dependency (e.g. '>=1.0.0').

optional.description: True if the dependency enhances but is not required for basic operation.

provenance.description: Supply-chain provenance of the package artifacts, per ADR-0019 (docs/adr/0019-secure-supply-chain-chainguard.md). First-party packages are built, signed (Cosign keyless), scanned (Trivy) and SBOM'd in CI.

sourceRepo.description: Canonical source repository the package manifests are generated from / vendored from.

upstreamChart.description: Optional upstream Helm chart reference (OCI or repo/chart) the manifests are rendered from.

signed.description: Whether the released package artifacts carry a cryptographic signature.

cosignKeyless.description: Whether signing uses Cosign keyless (Sigstore Fulcio + Rekor) as mandated by ADR-0019. Long-lived-key signing sets this false.

scanned.description: Whether the packaged/reference images are scanned (Trivy) for vulnerabilities before release.

scanner.description: Scanner used, when scanned is true (e.g. trivy).

sbom.description: Path (relative to the package directory) or URI of the SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX). Required once scanned is true for the SBOM inventory requirement of ADR-0019.

attestation.description: Optional SLSA provenance attestation reference (e.g. Rekor log index or in-toto URI).

planeAffinity.description: Where the package is intended to run: 'control-plane' (management/GitOps/control logic), 'data-plane' (workload nodes, per-node agents), or 'any'.

stability.description: Maturity tier. 'community' denotes an externally contributed package not yet first-party promoted. See MARKETPLACE.md for tier definitions.

resources.description: Coarse resource footprint hints used for capacity planning and local-vs-cloud gating. Values are advisory, not enforced limits.

cpu.description: Approximate steady-state CPU request across the package's workloads (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. '250m', '2').

memory.description: Approximate steady-state memory request (Kubernetes quantity, e.g. '512Mi', '2Gi').

storage.description: Persistent storage requested, if any (e.g. '10Gi', or '0' for stateless).

localSafe.description: Whether the package is safe to enable on a local Kind cluster (mirrors the appset enabled-gating intent).

keywords.description: Optional search tags for the marketplace listing.
